Generates a fresh email each run, so repeat runs never hit 409 or an unverified old user.
Local only. Finds the verify email for this run's user and saves verifyToken.

request.description: Uses {{verifyToken}} saved by the Mailpit request.
Run after 'Create organization'. Switches the token to that organization.
Pick a CSV file in the Body tab (key 'file'). Needs the worker running to process it.
Your system may enforce that the approver differs from the submitter (403/409). Approve from a second user to test the happy path.

exec: pm.test("Not allowed to read another tenant", () => pm.expect([403, 404]).to.include(pm.response.code));
